SessionStart.command: echo '{"additionalContext":"Hook system is active for this session."}'

PreToolUse.command: if echo "$HOOK_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -Eq 'rm -rf /|\"command\"\s*:\s*\"sudo '; then echo 'Blocked by hook policy: high-risk bash command.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0
if echo "$HOOK_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -Eq '\"command\"\s*:\s*\"(pytest|npm test|uv run pytest)'; then echo 'Hook hint: this test command may take a while.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
